Socomec power meters & submetering

From one load to multiple circuits.

Start with the information you need: energy use, demand, electrical measurements or power-quality events. Then match the hardware, sensors and communications to the application.

Single-point power & energy meters

Evaluate a meter for an individual feeder, panel or load. Socomec’s DIRIS A-40 is one panel-mounted option; DIRIS A-100 / A-200 models address power-quality metering and event analysis.

Browse Socomec monitoring products

Enclosed submetering

Consider DIRIS DigiBOX A when you need an enclosed metering approach. We help review the electrical system, enclosure requirements and sensor selection for your project.

Submetering & meter alternatives

Multi-point monitoring

DIRIS Digiware includes AC and DC monitoring options, interfaces and I/O modules. Tell us how many circuits you need to monitor and where the data needs to go.

Sensors, data & accessories

Round out the configuration with compatible current sensors, monitoring accessories and the appropriate data-collection approach. Review communications and software requirements before choosing components.

Discuss monitoring with MeterSight

MeterSight integration is reviewed for the selected device and configuration. Existing CTs, wiring and software connections should not be assumed compatible with a new meter.

Socomec disconnects, fuses & transfer switches

Selection starts with the application.

Non-fusible disconnect switches

Explore AC disconnects and DC/PV/ESS disconnect options. Share the system voltage, current rating, pole configuration and mounting requirements so we can help narrow the selection.

Fuses & fusible disconnects

Socomec’s fuse-protection group includes AC and DC fusible disconnects, modular fuse holders, BESS fuses, bolted-pressure switches and pullout switches.

For selection, provide the required fuse class or existing part number, electrical ratings and application details.

Socomec fuse-protection range

Manual, motorized & automatic transfer

Socomec offers manual, motorized and automatic transfer switches, along with ATS controllers. Tell us how the sources should be transferred and provide the project specification for review.

Socomec transfer-switch range

Enclosed switches & distribution

Evaluate enclosed disconnects or manual transfer switches, plus electronic protection, power distribution blocks, busbars, supports and associated mounting or cabling accessories.

A regional team for your Socomec project.

CT Electrical Sales is your Socomec representative for these product groups across all four states.

Whether you are comparing products, developing a specification, replacing an existing meter or coordinating a project quote, bring us the details early. We can help identify questions to resolve and coordinate with the manufacturer.

Contact our sales team

Before you request a quote.

Metering projects

Include voltage, wiring arrangement, current rating, circuit count, required measurements, sensor details and communications needs.

Switching & protection projects

Include voltage, amperage, AC/DC application, poles, enclosure needs, applicable specification and any existing product reference.

Which states does CT Electrical Sales represent for Socomec?

Utah, Idaho, Wyoming and Colorado for the Power Monitoring and Metering and Power Protection, Transfer & Distribution product groups.

Can you help evaluate an alternative to an existing meter?

Yes. Share the exact model and required functions. We evaluate the application rather than assuming another meter is a drop-in replacement. See our meter alternatives guide for starting points.

Does this page cover all Socomec businesses?

No. This page covers the two product groups listed above. UPS systems and other lines outside those groups are not included in the representation described here.
